name.quote: Aditya Birla Sun Life Insurance Waiver of Premium rider

linked_or_non_linked.value: linked rider (brochure carries the linked-products risk statement); separate rider premium
linked_or_non_linked.quote: Linked Insurance Products do not offer any liquidity

attached_to_ulips.note: Named by 9 of 10 ABSLI ULIPs; shown as not applicable in Smart Wealth Pension Plan.

waiver_of_premium.value: If the proposer becomes completely disabled by illness or accident, is diagnosed with one of 4 specified critical illnesses (heart attack, cancer and others), or dies (if not the life insured), the benefits under the base policy and all riders remain intact with no future premiums payable, for the rest of the policy term or until the proposer reaches 70. Only possible when taken at policy issue. Cover under this rider ends after a claim.
waiver_of_premium.quote: no future premiums payable by you throughout the rest of the policy term
waiver_of_premium.note: Unambiguous: the benefits "under the base policy and all riders" stay intact with no future premiums payable. The events are the proposer's.

waiver_on_death_of_life_assured.note: The rider is a premium waiver only.

waiver_on_death_or_illness_of_proposer.value: Death of the proposer (if not the life insured), the proposer's total and permanent disability (180 days) or one of 4 critical illnesses (survive 30 days).
waiver_on_death_or_illness_of_proposer.quote: Death of the proposer (if not the life insured)

critical_illness.value: No payout. Four listed major critical illnesses only trigger the waiver.
critical_illness.quote: We cover 4 major illnesses under this benefit

accidental_death.note: The rider is a premium waiver only.

accidental_disability.value: No payout. Disability of the proposer only triggers the waiver.
accidental_disability.note: The rider is a premium waiver only.

term_cover.note: The rider is a premium waiver only.

hospital_cash.note: The rider is a premium waiver only.

rider_term.value: Same as the base policy or until the proposer is 70, whichever is earlier.

premium_paying_rules.value: Premium paying term same as the rider term. Pay mode as the base policy. Can be opted only at policy issue.
premium_paying_rules.quote: You may opt for this rider only at the time of policy issue.

entry_age.value: 18 to 65 years; age at the end of the rider term at most 70

sum_assured_limits.note: No separate rider sum assured in the brochure; the benefit is the waived future premium.

premium_deduction.note: The brochure and policy text read do not say whether the rider premium is separate or from units. Needs a second read.
